description: I'm Mariam Hesham, a young software developer and entrepreneur passionate about AI, space technology, programming, and innovation. I'm leading TOT, a project inspired by Egypt's heritage and future space exploration, focused on analyzing potential human settlement environments, agriculture, and industrial opportunities beyond Earth. I'm looking for passionate team members skilled in AI/ML, data science, astronomy, aerospace, UI/UX, and research who want to build something impactful together.
summary: AI-powered platform that helps select the best lunar landing sites by analyzing safety, lighting, communication, human survival, oxygen, CO₂, and agricultural potential. Our goal is to make future Moon missions safer and more sustainable through AI and 3D visualization.
details:
TOT – Tutankhamun's Orbital Technology 🇪🇬🌕

TOT is an AI-powered lunar exploration and decision-support platform designed to make future Moon missions safer, smarter, and more sustainable.

Core Features

  • AI-Powered Site Selection: Identifies and evaluates suitable lunar landing locations.
  • Interactive 3D Moon: Visualizes the lunar surface, selected locations, lighting, and environmental conditions.
  • Lighting Analysis: Evaluates sunlight intensity, illumination, and potential solar energy availability.
  • Communication Analysis: Assesses Earth visibility and communication opportunities.
  • Human Survival Assessment: Analyzes oxygen, CO₂, environmental conditions, and estimated survival time with or without shelter.
  • Smart Agriculture: Identifies potential planting areas, evaluates agricultural feasibility, and explores suitable growing locations.
  • Resource Exploration: Provides information about underground resources and potential extraction depths.
  • AI Assistant: Explains complex scientific information and provides understandable recommendations.
  • Bilingual Experience: Supports Arabic and English to make space science more accessible.

Unique Value Proposition

Unlike traditional landing-site tools that primarily focus on location selection, TOT connects landing decisions with the bigger picture of establishing a sustainable human presence on the Moon.

What Makes TOT Different?

  1. Beyond Landing: From choosing a landing site to planning long-term lunar survival.
  2. Human-Centered Decisions: Prioritizes astronaut safety and survival.
  3. Agriculture Integration: Considers food production and future lunar farming.
  4. AI-Driven Insights: Turns complex data into understandable decisions.
  5. All-in-One Platform: Combines exploration, lighting, communication, survival, agriculture, and resources.
  6. Egyptian Identity: Brings ancient Egyptian inspiration into modern space technology through the name Tutankhamun.

Target Users

  • Space agencies and mission planners.
  • Astronauts and researchers.
  • Space science educators and students.
  • Future lunar settlement developers.

Business & Future Potential

TOT has potential to evolve into a lunar mission-planning platform for space agencies, research institutions, and educational organizations through institutional licensing, research partnerships, and educational subscriptions.

Vision

To move beyond simply finding a place to land and help humanity understand how to live, grow, and build a sustainable future beyond Earth.

TOT: From Landing to Living.
